title: Compatibility of explicit product embeddings with the coefficient transitions
statement: Let I be a preordered set, D : Iᵒᵖ → Sch, and F_i abelian sheaves on the small etale sites of D_i. Suppose phi_f : (D(f.op))^* F_i → F_j obeys the transported inverse-image composition law. Set J_k = Injective.under(F_k), e_k = Injective.ι(F_k), and FI_i to the outgoing-arrow product of direct images of J_k. Define a_i : F_i → FI_i by the product lift whose h component is the adjoint transpose of phi_h followed by e_k. Define psi_f as in the canonical product transition node. For each f : i → j, phi_f followed by a_j equals the inverse image of a_i along D(f.op) followed by psi_f. No identity law, monicity, directedness, or nonemptiness is needed.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 21.16.5, canonical components of psi and the adjoint components of gamma; coherence expanded using Stacks Tags 03CB and 0B65 and the existing Lean upper/lower-star comparison laws.

proof.text: Project the claimed equality to an outgoing g : j → k. Pi.lift_π on the left gives phi_f followed by the transpose of phi_g≫e_k. On the right, adjunction naturality moves the inverse image of a_i inside the transpose defining psi_f. Apply the injective adjunction homEquiv and the projection formula for a_i to obtain the transpose along D((f≫g).op) of phi_(f≫g)≫e_k, followed by inverse lowerStarComp. The transition-law node is used here only for its explicit transition definition; its pending law theorem is not used.

Replace phi_(f≫g) using the coefficient composition law. Expand homEquiv as unit followed by direct image. The unit mate equation upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app and naturality of lowerStarComp identify the resulting composite with the iterated adjoint transpose: naturality moves the maps across the comparison and its hom/inv cancel. The composite-adjunction unit formula and naturality of the inner unit finish the equality. This is the fully proved private adjointComp helper in Lean. Product extensionality closes the original square.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_coefficient_product_embedding_compatibility
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j) :
    φ f ≫ etaleCoefficientProductEmbedding D F φ j =
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).map
        (etaleCoefficientProductEmbedding D F φ i) ≫ etaleCoefficientProductTransition D F f
